Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. Driver 2 was stopped in the travel lane when the front
of Driver 1's vehicle struck the rear of Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 2 stated that the impact pushed the vehicle forward
and that Driver 2 struck the steering wheel. Driver 1 and Driver 2 both confirmed the sequence of events, and Driver 2
reported a concussion with headache and dizziness. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was present at the scene and
was able to describe the impact. Two independent witnesses stated that the collision occurred as described by both
drivers. Officers photographed the scene and both vehicles. The rear damage to Driver 2's vehicle and the front
damage to Driver 1's vehicle are consistent with the reported force of the impact. Officers observed no prior damage
to either vehicle. Driver 1 produced an insurance card showing coverage in Driver 1's own name. Driver 2 was
transported to a local hospital for evaluation. No citations were issued at the scene.
</page>
